mapper.select: SELECT q.*, (e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name) AS employee_name, e.employee_code, u.display_name AS assigned_hr_name, u.email AS assigned_hr_email FROM hr_queries q INNER JOIN employees e ON e.id = q.employee_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = q.assigned_hr_id WHERE q.id = #{id} AND q.company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hr_queries ( company_id, employee_id, assigned_hr_id, category, subject, message, priority, status ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{employeeId}, #{assignedHrId}, #{category}, #{subject}, #{message}, #{priority}, 'OPEN' )
mapper.update: UPDATE hr_queries SET hr_response = #{response}, status = COALESCE(#{status}, 'RESOLVED'), responded_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.display_name AS displayName, u.email, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, r.name AS role FROM users u INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE (r.name IN ('HR_ADMIN', 'HR_EXECUTIVE', 'SUPER_ADMIN')) AND u.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY u.id ASC
